anomalies.name: Spyglass
anomalies.description: Secretly inspect the entire hand of one opponent.

anomalies.name: Mob Swap
anomalies.description: Swap the positions of two Mobs. Ownership does not change.

anomalies.name: Trap
anomalies.description: Choose one of your Mobs. If an opponent attacks it this turn, destroy the attacking Mob before Power is compared.

anomalies.name: The Void
anomalies.description: Permanently banish one enemy Elite-or-lower Mob.

anomalies.name: Unstable Power
anomalies.description: Choose a Mob. Its Power becomes a random value between 50% and 150% of its original Power for its next battle.

anomalies.name: Mutation
anomalies.description: Choose one Mob. Its Power becomes 150% of its original Power for its next battle, rounded down.

anomalies.name: Lightning Strike
anomalies.description: Transform a Pig into a Zombified Piglin or a Creeper into a Charged Creeper. Otherwise give the chosen Mob +10 Power for its next battle.

anomalies.name: Nether Portal
anomalies.description: Choose one of your Mobs. It cannot be targeted until the start of your next turn.

anomalies.name: Respawn
anomalies.description: Return the last Mob destroyed on your side to the first empty slot on your board.

anomalies.name: Totem of Undying
anomalies.description: Give the Totem to one of your Mobs. The first time it would be destroyed, it survives instead and the Totem is consumed.

anomalies.name: TNT
anomalies.description: Choose two adjacent Mobs. Destroy both.

anomalies.name: Invisibility Potion
anomalies.description: Choose one of your Mobs. It cannot be targeted until the start of your next turn.

anomalies.name: Water Bucket
anomalies.description: Choose one Mob. Cancel its next battle and leave it in its current position.
